data.name: Serega Madness
data.detailed_description:
Serega Madness is a story-driven first-person adventure that combines exploration, puzzles, combat, action, and psychological horror.

You find yourself in the Dark World—a strange place inhabited by unusual creatures and governed by rules of its own.

At first, it may even seem welcoming.

But the Dark World is only pretending to be safe. Sooner or later, it will reveal its other side.

Trapped in a world filled with unknown dangers and strange creatures, you have only one way out: face the darkness and find a way to escape. This is the first chapter of the Serega Madness story.

You have entered the Dark World—a place inhabited by countless creatures. As you venture deeper into this unknown realm, one thing becomes clear: there is only one way out.

Explore mysterious towns, abandoned houses, dark corridors, and places whose very existence defies explanation.

Speak with the inhabitants of this world, discover hidden paths, and gradually uncover the story connecting you to the events unfolding around you.

Some characters will want to help you. Others will try to use you.

And some will appear completely harmless—until something changes.

Discover what lies hidden within the Dark World. A gripping story awaits—one that will keep you on the edge of your seat and leave you little time to catch your breath.

Find a way to escape this unknown realm. But remember: before you can leave this place behind, you will have to defeat the Darkness.

Serega Madness is built around the contrast between a colorful, stylized adventure and sudden moments of genuine horror.

The game does not try to frighten you every second. It gives you time to grow comfortable with its world and characters—only to shatter that sense of safety later.

  • A story-driven adventure filled with unusual characters and gradually unfolding mysteries.

  • A contrast between comfort and psychological horror, where seemingly safe places can change at any moment.

  • Unique enemies: Each chapter features distinct creatures with their own behaviors and unique artificial intelligence. Players will have to adapt their tactics in order to survive.

  • A dangerous world: Enemies are not the only threat. The Dark World is filled with traps, obstacles, and other dangers waiting to catch you off guard.

  • Varied gameplay mechanics that constantly encourage you to change your approach.

  • Stylized 3D visuals combining a cartoon-inspired aesthetic with subtle anime influences.

  • An original soundtrack that evolves alongside the mood of the story.

The horror adventure Serega Madness is coming soon to Steam, featuring puzzles, battles, memorable set pieces, and stylized visuals that will immerse you in a chilling journey.

data.short_description: Serega Madness is a single-player horror adventure game set in a Dark world. Solve interesting puzzles while hiding from the insidious horrors waiting for you in the shadows.

English*, Russian*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 690 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 60fps Low settings at 1080p

Recommended:

  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER / AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 60fps Ultra settings at 1080p
